parole.significato: making a hole, digging out, making hollow; excavation; a mine, a trench
parole.testo: Probably a Northwestern Iranian borrowing, also found in Azerbaijani nəğım, nəğm, Middle Armenian նաղմ (naġm), Central Kurdish نەغم (neẍim, “tunnel”), Ottoman Turkish لغم (lağım), Arabic لَغْم (laḡm), لَغَم (laḡam), لُغْم (luḡm, “mine, tunnel”), and again Persian نغن (naġan, “navel-hole”).
